name: io.github.zepgram/toyota
description: Connect a MyToyota or MyLexus Europe account to any MCP client: fuel, range, location, trips, EV share, health, climate and charging, plus optional remote commands.

environmentVariables.name: TOYOTA_VIN
environmentVariables.description: VIN selector when several vehicles share the account

environmentVariables.name: TOYOTA_BRAND
environmentVariables.description: T for Toyota (default), L for Lexus

environmentVariables.name: TOYOTA_USE_METRIC
environmentVariables.description: true (default) for km/L, false for miles/gallons

packageArguments.name: --addresses
packageArguments.description: osm (worldwide addresses) or fr (French addresses and fuel prices)
